leah (sec): quick note: pentest flagged backup-agent creating /tmp/backup-ctx-<id>.json with 0644. contains cmk alias + tenant id. no key material but PII in metadata.
dan (infra): rolling hotfix to write to tmpfs and set 0600. will also add ctx-hash instead of raw tenant id. PR incoming.
marco (sre): we need to change IAM: backup role should be kms:Encrypt only. restores use a separate role that gets short-lived kms:Decrypt via an assumption flow. measure restore latency impact.
